_: Scenar nahovoru EN (src/copy/vo_kratka.en.json), vyrobeny scripts/vo_lang_init.py z src/copy/vo_kratka.json. Casy `at` su slovenske (obraz sa nemeni); `sk` = povodna veta (len pre kontrolu). Kym je `_voice` false, `dur` a `partAt` su zastupne slovenske hodnoty a video sa renderuje bez hlasu. Hlas: node scripts/vo.mjs --engine gemini --script <tento subor> --dir public/<vo|vo-kratka>-en, potom `_voice: true`.
_style: calm, matter-of-fact corporate narrator; neutral, clear British English; fluent and connected, a bit brisker than a documentary narrator; only a short breath at commas, a longer pause only at the end of a sentence; no extra emotion. Pronunciation: the brand name Assetin is read as written, a-se-tin with a hard t; Archives as in English. Say QR as 'cue are'. Codes like PL_01, KR_01, ZL_03 are read as English letter names plus the plain number, without the underscore and the leading zero: 'P L one, K R one, Z L three'.

K46-C2-Hladanie.text: When did you last struggle to find a document?
K46-C2-Hladanie.sk: Kedy ste naposledy nevedeli nájsť nejaký dokument?

K46-C5-Teren.text: Every item gets a QR code.
K46-C5-Teren.styleExtra: Calm, clear, falling intonation at the end.

K46-C5-Teren.text: An ordinary phone is all you need.
K46-C5-Teren.styleExtra: Calm, clear, short statement in one breath; a gentle emphasis on ordinary; falling intonation at the end.

K46-C8-Ponuka.text: Let's start with one box, free and with no obligation.
K46-C8-Ponuka.sk: Začnime jednou krabicou, zadarmo a nezáväzne.
K46-C8-Ponuka.styleExtra: Tone for this sentence: warm, confident and inviting, a clear call to action.

K46-C4-Cena.styleExtra: Warm, confident introduction, falling intonation at the end.

K46-Hook.text: Scanning an entire archive can be expensive.
K46-Hook.sk: Naskenovať celý archív môže byť drahé.
K46-Hook.styleExtra: Calm, matter-of-fact statement; a gentle emphasis on expensive; falling intonation at the end.

K46-Hook.text: Our app photographs only the title page.
K46-Hook.sk: Naša aplikácia fotí len identifikačnú stranu.

K46-Vysledok.text: The result: you know for certain which documents you have and where they are.
parts: The result: you know for certain
which documents you have and where they are.
K46-Vysledok.sk: Výsledok: spoľahlivo viete, aké dokumenty máte a kde sa nachádzajú.

K46-Vysledok.text: Then you can decide what to keep, what to shred and what to fully scan.
parts: what to keep, what to shred
K46-Vysledok.sk: Potom viete rozhodnúť, čo uchovať, skartovať alebo plnohodnotne skenovať.

K46-Kto.text: Either you catalogue it yourselves, or we process your archive for you, turnkey.
parts: or we process your archive for you, turnkey.
K46-Kto.sk: Buď katalogizujete sami, alebo vám archív spracujeme na kľúč.

K46-F3-Vyhladavanie.text: Then just type a keyword. The app shows the path to the item and all the extracted data.

K46-F3-Vyhladavanie.sk: Potom stačí napísať kľúčové slovo. Aplikácia ukáže cestu k položke aj všetky vyčítané údaje.
